title: Workspaces overview
description: Requests through the workspace routers and pipeline logs of the workspace agents, per workspace.

list.name: workspace
list.label: Workspace
list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT workspace FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
) ORDER BY toUInt64OrZero(workspace)

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT workspace FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-')
) ORDER BY toUInt64OrZero(workspace)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT workspace AS Workspace, req.requests AS Requests, req.errors / nullIf(req.requests, 0) AS `5xx`, req.p95 AS `p95 latency`,
  lg.lines AS `Log lines`, lg.stderr AS `stderr lines`, greatest(req.last, lg.last) AS `Last activity`
FROM (
  SELECT substring(ServiceName, 4) AS workspace, count() AS requests, countIf(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) >= 500) AS errors,
    quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS p95, max(Timestamp) AS last
  FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) GROUP BY workspace
) AS req
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace, count() AS lines, countIf(LogAttributes['source'] = 'stderr') AS stderr, max(Timestamp) AS last
  FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) GROUP BY workspace
) AS lg USING workspace
ORDER BY Requests DESC, `Log lines` DESC
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

panels.title: Requests

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, substring(ServiceName, 4) AS workspace, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, workspace ORDER BY time

panels.description: Requests per second through the workspace routers. Only workspaces with request tracing turned on send them.

panels.title: 5xx responses

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, substring(ServiceName, 4) AS workspace, countIf(toUInt16OrZero(if(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'] != '', SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'], SpanAttributes['http.status_code'])) >= 500) / count() AS value
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, workspace ORDER BY time

panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, substring(ServiceName, 4) AS workspace, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1e9 AS value
FROM otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND startsWith(ServiceName, 'ws-') AND substring(ServiceName, 4) IN (${workspace:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, workspace ORDER BY time

panels.title: Log lines

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, workspace ORDER BY time

panels.description: Pipeline output lines per second the workspace agents send.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) AS time, LogAttributes['workspaceId'] AS workspace, count() / $__interval_s AS value
FROM otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['workspaceId'] IN (${workspace:singlequote}) AND LogAttributes['source'] = 'stderr' GROUP BY time, workspace ORDER BY time
